full_judgment: 4. An affidavit-in-opposition has been filed on behalf of the respondent No. 1. It has been stated therein that the petitioner was involved in a number of criminal cases of various nature. He has earned a ill-reputation in locality for his rude and rough behaviour. He even manhandled the Principal of Fakirhat College which caused a serious commotion in the locality. The Chairman of Fakirhat Union Parishad submitted a prayer to the Deputy Commissioner, Bagerhat, respondent No. 2, for cancellation of the licence of the revolver issued to the petitioner. The allegations of the Union Parishad Chairman were thoroughly inquired into by the Additional Superintendent of Police, Bagerhat who found the allegations to be substantially correct. It has been alleged that the petitioner is a man of desperate temperament. He brandishes his revolver and threatens to kill respectable men with whom he differs. He threatened to kill one Nawab Ali Fakir, Chairman, Fakirhat Upazila Parishad, in broad daylight. The Additional Superintendent of Police recommended an immediate cancellation of his revolver licence which was endorsed by the Superintendent of Police, the Deputy Commissioner, Bagerhat and the Divisional Commissioner of Khulna. All these recommendations were sent to the respondent No.' and the order of cancellation of licence was passed by the Minister of Home Affairs after going through the aforesaid reports and recommendations. Annexure-B is only a communication of the decision taken by the Minister. The licence was cancelled on bonafide grounds and the question of malafide does not arise. The respondent No. 4 has not influenced anybody. The inquiry against the petitioner was instituted on 20-1-84, long before he filed the suit against the respondent No. 4.
